note: Project rules for the lane dashboard export (scripts/coordination/export-dash-data.mjs). Rules run in order, first match wins: pass 1 is idRe or ids, pass 2 is tracks, else unassigned. idRe must start with ^ and every alternative is anchored by lane-dash-project.mjs. terminalLanes are the lanes that must all be done for the project to be Done. goal and done are proposals Dave edits. parked, proposed and focus are page flags. greymatter-design has its own board and no rule here.
